title: When 37signals Put Everything but Basecamp on the Shelf
conflicts: Staff: 43 in the 2014 letter and Tech.co vs the founders' 2023 recollection of 20 to 30-something; story uses 43. Timing: the letter dates the product review to August 2013, the podcast show notes call the hotel meeting 'the 2014 meeting'; story leaves the meeting undated. Highrise did not stop selling in 2014 (it was spun off in August 2014 and returned in 2018); story says only Campfire stopped taking new customers.
notes: Primary source is the 5 February 2014 letter via an Internet Archive capture of 37signals.com. The wedding, the Chicago hotel room and DHH's 'only work on things we're proud of' come from the founders' 2023 REWORK podcast and are attributed as recollection. Funding is bootstrapped, with a small 2006 stake sold to Jeff Bezos (noted). Stance 'complicates': the company reversed the rename in May 2022.
